# A.S. Traders - Animal Feed Supplements & Veterinary Nutrition

> A.S. Traders is a supplier and distributor of veterinary feed supplements, mineral mixtures, bypass fats, rumen buffers, and livestock nutrition products based in Moga, Punjab, India.

## Core Products
- R.S. RAKSHAK: Cattle feed additive for rumen buffering, toxin binding, and milk yield support.
- R.S. MIN Mineral Mixture: High Calcium (28%) & Phosphorus (12%) mineral feed supplement for dairy cattle.
- CAL-PHOS D.C.P.+: Dicalcium phosphate supplement with zinc and iron for cattle and poultry.
- CALCIUM PHOS AD3 PLUS: Mineral and vitamin feed supplement with Vitamins A & D3.
- FERRICAL-L: Liquid iron, calcium, and lysine tonic for vitality and blood formation.
- R.S. BUFF: Rumen buffer and digestive animal feed supplement with sodium bicarbonate and liver extracts.
- R.S. CAL-12+: High-potency liquid calcium, phosphorus, and mineral supplement.

## Target Audience
Dairy farmers, commercial feed millers, veterinary distributors, and livestock breeders across India.
